background: Mack Bradley is a Sublette County commissioner, serving through the end of the current term on January 2, 2027. The official commissioner profiles page lists him as a member with that term date. He won the November 2022 general election and lost the August 2026 Republican primary for a new term. Official July 14, 2025, commissioners proceedings record that he seconded the motion to appoint Jessica Rice as interim county clerk. Incoming commissioner Robin Schamber takes office in January 2027.
